# CLI-Anything: Turn Any Desktop App into an AI Agent CLI

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dd9NdbFxJLo/ · **Type:** Reel · **Author:** Neeraj Chemburkar · **Saved:** 2026-10-03

**Why I saved it:** CLI Anything

## Summary

CLI-Anything is an open-source framework that bridges AI agents and desktop applications by converting graphical interface controls into text-based command-line interfaces. Instead of relying on computer vision or mouse clicks, LLM agents can run CLI commands to execute actions across software like Blender, OBS, and Obsidian.

## Caption

Comment “APPS” and I’ll DM you the link to this repo.

There’s a repo that lets Claude use almost any software on your computer, just by asking.

It’s called CLI-Anything. Most desktop software is built for people clicking buttons, so AI agents have a tough time using it. CLI-Anything gives each app a text version of its controls, a CLI, which is the thing AI agents are really good at.

There’s already a hub of 79 ready-made CLIs: OBS for recording, Zoom, Obsidian, Blender, GIMP, LibreOffice, Audacity and more. Install one, then just tell Claude what you want done. The repo’s own demos show an agent building a 3D drone in Blender and a rover in FreeCAD this way.

If your app isn’t in the hub yet, you point the repo at the app’s code and it builds the CLI for you, tests included. To be clear, the real app still has to be installed on your machine, and it works best on software with open source code.

Free and Apache 2.0 licensed. Over 51,000 stars on GitHub as of October 1, 2026.
